root_cause: The native dialog.showModal() does not reliably focus the autofocus element in this environment. Previous synchronous focus attempts in _showElement race with browser focus management, leaving focus on the trigger or body.
repair_strategy: In DialogBase._show, after calling _showElement, yield to the microtask queue (await Promise.resolve()) then explicitly focus the autofocus element (or dialog fallback). This allows native focus management to complete before we set focus.
expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard focus moves into the drawer when opened, landing on the search field so users can immediately type or Tab to filters without a pointer.
functional_risks: Potential focus theft if autofocus element is not focusable (mitigated by fallback to dialog).
Risk of double-focus if browser already moved focus (mitigated by yielding to microtask).
verification_requirements: After activating the drawer button with Enter, focus is on #filters-search.
Pressing Tab moves focus to #in-stock checkbox.
Closing the drawer with Escape returns focus to the trigger button.
